Tucker Center]] |champion = [[Jacksonville Classic]] Duval champions |tourney = |tourney_result = }} {{2021–22 ACC men's basketball standings}} The '''2021–22 Florida State Seminoles men's basketball team''' represented [[Florida State University]] during the [[2021–22 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Seminoles were led by head coach [[Leonard Hamilton]], in his 20th year, and played their home games at the [[Donald L. Tucker Civic Center|Donald L. Tucker Center]] on the university's [[Tallahassee, Florida]] campus as members of the [[Atlantic Coast Conference]]. The Seminoles finished the season 17–14 overall and 10–10 in [[2021–22 Atlantic Coast Conference men's basketball season|ACC play]] to finish in eight place. As the eighth seed in the [[2022 ACC men's basketball tournament|ACC tournament]], they lost to [[2021–22 Syracuse Orange men's basketball team|Syracuse]] in their Second Round matchup.
